statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-15558 lives in the Docker CLI plugin-manager package (github.com/docker/cli/cli-plugins/manager). knative-serving pulls github.com/docker/cli in only as an indirect dependency and imports solely github.com/docker/cli/cli/config (via go-containerregistry authn for image-pull credentials); `go mod why github.com/docker/cli/cli-plugins/manager` reports that the main module does not need that package, and it is not vendored, so the vulnerable code is never compiled into any knative-serving binary on any platform. The flaw is additionally Windows-only (manager_windows.go, excluded by Go build constraints), while this image is built exclusively for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. The scanner matches the transitively resolved github.com/docker/cli version against the advisory range regardless of reachability, so this statement is required to clear the false positive.

Affects the Docker CLI module bundled transitively by the devfile-gem Go binary. The fixed Docker CLI version does not build with the Docker API module versions available to this upstream dependency tree, so this requires upstream devfile-gem dependency updates.
